description:
Remove the dead-code warning that `crates/gf2-core/src/alg/m4rm.rs` emits in every build without the `test-support` feature.

## Background

`choose_k_block` (about line 532) has one caller, `multiply_rowwise_for_test` (about line 1155), which is gated on `test` or `test-support`. A plain release build of `gf2-core` therefore warns `function choose_k_block is never used`; `cargo-ci` runs Clippy with `--all-features` and never observes it. Surfaced by the 9fb40c83 profile build in the 2026-09-16 benchmark window.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A release build of `gf2-core` without `test-support` emits no dead-code warning for `choose_k_block`, either by gating the helper like its only caller or by giving it a production caller.
- [hard] REQ-02: `cargo clippy -p gf2-core --release -- -D warnings` (default features) passes and the `--all-features` CI run is unchanged.

## Notes

Found by the 9fb40c83 worker while rebuilding the DVB profile arms.
title: Remove or gate the dead choose_k_block helper in m4rm
